prompt: Who is the only female artist to have topped Spotify's list of most-streamed artists in three consecutive years (2020–2022)?
answer: No one. Bad Bunny topped Spotify’s overall most-streamed artists list from 2020–2022; Taylor Swift was the most-streamed female artist in those years but ranked second overall in 2021 and 2022.
